articles.title: National Data Governance Framework & Ethical AI Guidelines
articles.summary: MeitY releases updated operational guidelines for non-personal data governance and AI transparency mechanisms in public service delivery.
prelims: Establishes the National Data Management Office (NDMO) under the Ministry of Electronics & IT.
Focuses primarily on non-personal data (NPD) generated across government departments.
Mandates algorithmic audit logs for high-risk automated decision systems in public governance.
articles.mains: Examine how the National Data Governance Policy can balance data-driven public service delivery with citizen privacy and ethical AI deployment.

articles.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Infrastructure Sync
articles.summary: High-level steering committee assesses port-rail integration readiness across India's western seaboard for IMEC execution.
prelims: IMEC consists of the East Corridor (connecting India to the Arabian Gulf) and the Northern Corridor (connecting the Gulf to Europe).
Includes multi-modal transportation links alongside hydrogen pipelines and high-speed data cables.
Key Indian nodes identified include Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT), Mundra, and Kandla ports.
articles.mains: Analyze the strategic and geopolitical significance of IMEC for India's foreign policy amidst evolving global trade dynamics.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: Green Ammonia and Methanol Norms
articles.summary: Government notifies updated carbon intensity thresholds for green hydrogen derivatives to accelerate decarbonization in heavy industries.
prelims: National Green Hydrogen Mission targets at least 5 MMT annual production of Green Hydrogen by 2030.
SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) scheme provides financial incentives for electrolyser manufacturing.
Nodal Ministry responsible for implementation is the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
articles.mains: Evaluate the potential of green hydrogen derivatives in decarbonizing India's hard-to-abate industrial sectors such as steel, fertilizers, and shipping.

articles.title: High Seas Treaty (BBNJ Agreement) and Marine Conservation
articles.summary: India advances domestic ratification protocols for the Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ) Agreement under UNCLOS.
prelims: Operates under the framework of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
Applies to marine areas beyond national jurisdiction (beyond the 200 nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone).
Mandates Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs) for commercial activities in international ocean zones.
articles.mains: Discuss the institutional and regulatory challenges in implementing the BBNJ Treaty to protect marine biodiversity in international waters.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: MATSYA 6000 Submersible Trials
articles.summary: National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) achieves milestone shallow-water integration tests for the crewed MATSYA 6000 submersible.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is designed to take three human aquanauts to a ocean depth of 6,000 meters.
Implemented under India's flagship Deep Ocean Mission led by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
Aims to explore polymetallic nodules containing key critical minerals like nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
articles.mains: Highlight India's strategic interest in deep-sea mineral exploration while balancing marine ecological preservation.
